raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "In-plane dimensions of the 2-D design domain",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 and Table 1 give no in-plane dimensions or aspect ratio. Sec. 4.5 fixes the longest side at 1 mm; dimensions stated for other examples do not determine this case.",
      "readings": [
        "Rectangle of length L = 1 mm and height H = 0.5 mm.",
        "Rectangle of length L = 1 mm and height H = 1/3 mm."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Uniform out-of-plane thickness of the 2-D model",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No thickness is specified for converting the stated Young's modulus and force into a 2-D stiffness model.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit thickness t = 1 mm.",
        "Thin plate thickness t = 0.1 mm."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Cantilever clamp",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Table 1's Boundary Conditions entry has no accessible geometric description. Sec. 4.1 does not identify the restrained edge or attachment extent. The example in Sec. 3.2.1 concerns the separate 3-D case.",
      "readings": [
        "Both translations fixed along the entire left end.",
        "Both translations fixed along the entire right end.",
        "Both translations fixed only on the central 20% of the left end."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Applied force location",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 provides no force coordinates; the Table 1 Boundary Conditions entry supplies no accessible location. Load locations described for later 3-D examples do not settle this case.",
      "readings": [
        "Free-end midpoint: x/L = 1, y/H = 0.5, using a corner-based frame with the clamp at x = 0.",
        "Free-end bottom corner: x/L = 1, y/H = 0.",
        "Free-end top corner: x/L = 1, y/H = 1."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "Direction of the applied force",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The global force magnitude in Sec. 4.5 does not specify its direction. No direction is stated for Table 1 outside its unavailable boundary-condition depiction.",
      "readings": [
        "Transverse force in the negative y direction.",
        "Axial force in the positive x direction.",
        "Oblique force along (1, -1)/sqrt(2)."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Spatial distribution of the applied force",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3.2.2 formulates loading as traction over an area A, while Sec. 4.5 gives a force and mentions force-location points. Neither specifies the 2-D loaded extent or force distribution for Table 1.",
      "readings": [
        "A concentrated nodal force with resultant 0.1 N.",
        "Uniform traction over the central 10% of the free end, with resultant 0.1 N.",
        "Uniform traction over the entire free end, with resultant 0.1 N."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Non-design cells, particularly at loads and supports",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 does not specify a passive-density mask or whether attachment cells must remain solid. Passive regions described in Sec. 4.5 belong to other examples.",
      "readings": [
        "All cells are designable; no passive regions.",
        "A one-element solid strip at the clamp and a one-element solid pad adjoining the load are held at density 1."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Young's modulus and Poisson's ratio are stated globally, but Sec. 3.2.2 explicitly presents a 3-D energy formulation. No plane-stress or plane-strain reduction is specified for Sec. 4.1.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress: out-of-plane stresses vanish.",
        "Plane strain: out-of-plane strains vanish."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Structured-grid resolution for Table 1",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No 2-D element counts are given. Sec. 4.6's blanket statement that the SIMP grid has more than 6000 points does not determine the resolution. Meshes specified elsewhere are for other examples.",
      "readings": [
        "120 by 60 elements for a 2:1 rectangle with square cells.",
        "160 by 80 elements for a 2:1 rectangle with square cells.",
        "200 by 100 elements for a 2:1 rectangle with square cells."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Finite-element formulation and integration",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 and Sec. 4.1 identify FEA and a cited SIMP implementation, but the supplied text does not state element order or quadrature.",
      "readings": [
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with 2 by 2 Gauss integration.",
        "Eight-node quadratic quadrilaterals with 3 by 3 Gauss integration."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Minimum FE density and treatment of void cells",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 specifies cubic stiffness interpolation for the neural energy calculation, but no positive density floor or zero-stiffness treatment is stated for the structured-grid SIMP and validation FEA.",
      "readings": [
        "Allow density 0 and remove zero-stiffness void cells from the state problem.",
        "Impose minimum density 0.001 while retaining the stated cubic interpolation.",
        "Impose minimum density 0.01 while retaining the stated cubic interpolation."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Density-filter weighting kernel",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 specifies a density filter with radius 1.5 element sizes, but does not state its weighting kernel.",
      "readings": [
        "Linear distance weights: w = max(0, r - d), normalized over the neighborhood.",
        "Equal weights for every element center within radius r, normalized over the neighborhood."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Density-filter boundary treatment",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 does not explain how filter neighborhoods crossing the design-domain boundary are handled.",
      "readings": [
        "Truncate the neighborhood and renormalize using only in-domain weights.",
        "Pad outside the domain with zero density and retain full-neighborhood normalization.",
        "Reflect the density field across the domain boundary before filtering."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Filter-radius metric if grid cells are rectangular",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4's '1.5 times the mesh element size' does not define a radius for unequal x and y spacings; square cells are not explicitly specified.",
      "readings": [
        "Radius 1.5 in element-index coordinates, giving physical semiaxes 1.5 times each grid spacing.",
        "Circular physical radius 1.5 times the smaller grid spacing.",
        "Circular physical radius 1.5 times the larger grid spacing."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial density field for the 2-D structured-grid optimization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No initial SIMP density field is stated for Table 1. The uniform density 0.5 initialization in Sec. 4.2 is explicitly attached to the separate 3-D example.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform density 0.5.",
        "Density 0.6 in the left half and 0.4 in the right half, preserving mean density 0.5."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "SIMP density-update rule and move controls",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 cites a SIMP code without providing its update equations or move limits. SIMP's stated cubic interpolation does not itself specify an optimization algorithm.",
      "readings": [
        "Optimality-criteria updates with maximum density change 0.2 per iteration.",
        "Optimality-criteria updates with maximum density change 0.1 per iteration.",
        "MMA updates with maximum density change 0.1 per iteration."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "SIMP termination criterion",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 says only 'default convergence criterion', without a monitored quantity, tolerance, or iteration cap. The explicit tolerance and cap in Sec. 4.4 apply to a different 3-D solver example.",
      "readings": [
        "Stop when maximum element-density change is below 0.01, with no fixed iteration cap.",
        "Stop when maximum element-density change is below 0.001, with no fixed iteration cap.",
        "Stop when maximum element-density change is below 0.01 or after 200 iterations."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
